subject: ClearHarbor - tenant lifecycle artifacts and deletion proof request
messages:
From: Jenna Alvarez <jenna.alvarez@clarity-audit.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@clearharbor.com
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tenant lifecycle artifacts for ClearHarbor (SOC2)

Hi Michael / Lauren,

We're beginning our retention/deletion control work for ClearHarbor's SOC 2 scope. To complete the control testing for CC6 (data disposal) and CC7 (retention) we need a small set of artifacts from Redwood for the tenant: clearharbor-prod. Specifically: 

- Copy of the current deletion runbook or standard operating procedure for tenant data erasure (including approval/trigger criteria).
- Mapping table showing which storage locations and services (S3 buckets, backups, snapshots, caches, KV stores) are covered by the tenant TTL/purge.
- Example audit logs showing a completed deletion run for a sample data object (object id acceptable) with timestamps and job ids.
- Confirmation of data residency considerations for that tenant (which region the data was removed from).

Can you provide the items above by EOD PT on Mon 31 Aug? If any items require redaction or a secure transfer method, let us know and we'll provide a secure upload link.

Thanks,
Jenna Alvarez
Senior IT Auditor
Clarity Audit Partners

--
Disclaimer: This message contains audit-related requests and may contain sensitive information.
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Alvarez <jenna.alvarez@clarity-audit.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2025 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: tenant lifecycle artifacts for ClearHarbor (SOC2)

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear list. We'll gather these and aim to deliver by your requested deadline. A couple quick clarifications so we pull exactly what you need: 

1) For the "example audit logs" — is a CSV extract with headers (job_id, object_id, bucket, action, timestamp, actor) acceptable, or do you need the native audit-log format?
2) For the mapping table — do you want a simple service-level mapping (service -> covered? -> notes) or a full inventory (bucket names, ARN, retention TTL)?

I'll coordinate with Irene on the runbook and with Lauren on the production deletion job output. If you prefer, we can place files in a secure folder and send a short SSO link.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0188

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 31 Aug 2025 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: tenant lifecycle artifacts for ClearHarbor (SOC2)

Jenna — attaching the items we agreed to provide. See short notes below.

Attachments:
- deletion_runbook_v3.pdf (pdf) — operational runbook that describes trigger paths (age-based TTL, legal/DSR requests, tenant offboarding), roles (RunOps, Security, Customer Success sign-off), and verification steps. Sensitive sections (internal hostnames) redacted.
- s3-deletion-log-20250815.csv (csv) — exported audit rows for a test tenant purge we ran 2025-08-15: includes job_id, object_id (hashed), bucket_name (redacted to tenant-clearharbor-*), action, timestamp, operator_id.
- lifecycle-policy-mapping.xlsx (xlsx) — simple mapping of services and TTLs (S3 lifecycle, DB retention, snapshots, caches).

Notes: 
- Deletion job id: RBW-PURGE-20250815-91 (included in CSV). That job removed object keys that had been expired per the ClearHarbor customer TTL. The job operated in us-west-2; backups in archival storage are covered by the retention mapping (snapshots have a 90-day retention before eligible for deletion).
- We do not currently have single-record cryptographic proof-of-deletion; our evidence model is operational logs + runbook + job output checksums. If the auditor requires additional artefacts (e.g., secure time-stamped manifests), we can run a targeted purge and provide a signed manifest.

Let us know if you want the full, unredacted runbook — we can provide that via Redwood Secure Transfer (SSO+mfa) and a narrow NDA addendum.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Compliance & Product Security
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: tenant lifecycle artifacts for ClearHarbor (SOC2)

Thanks Lauren, Michael — received and reviewing. A couple follow-ups after an initial pass: 

- The CSV sample looks good; can you confirm the hashing algorithm used for object_id? We need to show how the object identifier was obfuscated.
- For the lifecycle spreadsheet, please add a column that indicates whether snapshots/backups are handled by an automated lifecycle or by a retention ticket (manual).
- We'd like a signed manifest for RBW-PURGE-20250815-91 that contains job_id, timestamp, and a SHA256 checksum of the job output file. If you can produce that manifest (signed by an internal operator) and upload to the secure folder, that will close out CC6 evidence for the sample.

If you can get those three small items into the folder today, we'll mark the sample evidence as "controls operating effectively" for the testing window.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jenna
Senior IT Auditor
Clarity Audit Partners
